description: Set how a post opens (its hook: a question, a number, a story...), which insights_get hooks compares. Rules tag every post from the recorder's script or the caption's first line; a tag set here wins and the rules never change it. visual_type does the same for how the video looks in its first moments (face close-up, fast cut, text on screen...). post_id: a post from post_list, or one made outside the app from insights_get (a post made here keeps the tag on itself). type null hands the post back to the rules, which tag it again from its caption; visual_type null hands the look back to the passes that measure the video. Undo with undo restores both.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

seconds.description: How long the opening runs in the video, in seconds

text.description: The opening line, when it isn't the caption's first line (said or shown on screen, say)

type.description: The hook type, or null to let the rules tag it again; leave out to keep the text tag and set only visual_type

visual_type.description: How the video looks at the start (face_close, fast_cut, text_card...), the main one; null hands it back to the passes that measure the video; leave out to keep it. The passes never change one set here

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_hook_set
title: Tag a post's hook
